payload.name: youtube-content
payload.old_string:
## Error Handling

- **Transcript disabled**: tell the user; suggest they check if subtitles are available on the video page.
- **Private/unavailable video**: relay the error and ask the user to verify the URL.
- **No matching language**: retry without `--language` to fetch any available transcript, then note the actual language to the user.
- **Dependency missing**: run `uv pip install youtube-transcript-api` and retry.
payload.new_string:
## Error Handling

- **Transcript disabled**: tell the user; suggest they check if subtitles are available on the video page.
- **Private/unavailable video**: relay the error and ask the user to verify the URL.
- **No matching language**: retry without `--language` to fetch any available transcript, then note the actual language to the user.
- **Dependency missing**: run `uv pip install youtube-transcript-api` and retry.
- **VPS/cloud IP blocked by YouTube**: the helper script errors with "IP has been blocked" or "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot". Fall back to step 3 (delegate_task with web+search toolsets). Do not retry the script — YouTube will keep blocking the same IP. Common external sources to search: video title + "transcript", video ID + "transcript", "listennotes.com", "youtubetranscript.com". Set the task context with the confirmed title, channel, and video ID so the subagent can search precisely.
